title: Configurable site name applied consistently to UI and document metadata

requirements.summary: Create a single configured website name and use it for both the browser title and the only visible landing-page text.
acceptanceCriteria: There is one clearly-defined place to update the website name string (no duplicated hard-coded copies across files).
The browser tab/page title matches the configured website name.
On initial load, the only visible on-page text matches the configured website name exactly (no additional labels, buttons, footers, or helper text).

file_operations.description: Add a single source of truth export for the website name (site title/branding string) to be reused across the app.
Replace hard-coded on-page text with the configured website name and set the browser document title from the same configured value (ensuring no additional visible UI text is introduced).
Remove the hard-coded website name from the static <title> so the runtime-configured title (from the single source of truth) is authoritative and avoids duplicated strings.

requirements.summary: Add non-visible HTML head metadata (including Open Graph title) derived from the configured website name without adding visible UI text.
acceptanceCriteria: The HTML head contains metadata for the site that uses the same configured website name string (at minimum: title/og:title).
No new visible text appears on the landing page after these metadata changes.

file_operations.description: Create a small helper to apply head metadata using the configured website name (at minimum setting document title and ensuring an og:title meta tag exists/updates) without affecting visible UI.

Wire the site metadata helper to run on initial load using the configured website name, ensuring og:title and document title match while keeping the rendered page text unchanged (still only the website name).
